description: An API's primary OpenAPI reference (url) — the top agent intent; set include=["content"] to inline the spec body.

aid.description: API id in the form provider:api-slug, as find_apis returns it, e.g. "stripe:stripe-api".

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline each artifact's body instead of just its URL.

name: get_openapi
